purpose: the loop's mechanism knowledge base (created per the R130 verdict dir 3): transferable, evidence-cited findings about WHERE the pipeline fails and WHAT counters it — recorded, never silently relied on; every finding cites its evidence bytes

findings.finding: the reviewer stage's failure mode is OVER-REWRITING: fixing surfaced findings by restating/reorganizing the whole bill breaks clean sentences (the duty_pricing residual is introduced post-fix)
findings.countermeasure: a DIFF-MINIMIZATION clause: change ONLY the sentences the findings touch; carry every other sentence of the original verbatim
findings.anti_pattern: MORE derivation rules — m1_duty_rule and m4_m1m2 INTRODUCED defects (1/12 each): derive-or-delete wording makes the reviewer ADD duty figures to bills that had none
evidence: eval/r130_gepa_ablation.json (the twin's stage-1 Pareto front: m5 0 defects, heal 0.083 vs incumbent 0.000; m1/m4 harmful)
eval/r130s3_diffmin_scoring.json (the held-out paired re-test: v2 2/48 <= v1 2/48 defect rows and heal 0 >= 0 — NO REGRESSION, the preregistered fold gate PASS)

findings.finding: the duty_pricing residual behaves as a ~2/48-per-draw RATE property under agnes-3.0-flash sampling, not a fixed item property: the committed incumbent rows (r125-05-s2/d1 + r125-07-s2/d1), the live v1 replay rows (r125-06-s1/d1 + r125-12-s2/d2) and the v2 replay rows (r125-09-s2/d1 + r125-01-s2/d2) all tally 2/48 duty_pricing with ~zero pid overlap across the three draws
findings.implication: single-draw defect ROWS are not deterministic targets; class-level rate comparisons (the primary metric) are the stable instrument; Art. 3 byte-consistency stays valid on TALLIES (a tally pin reproduces, an item-level defect pin would be over-fit)
